title: Data enrichment Round 5: persons + clubs enrichment, ownership corrections, unit-error fixes
description: Integrate research/round4/person-enrichment.md (110/110 persons: nationality/industry/role/status + ownership-confidence tiers; ~20 name-variant dupes + ~15 institutional placeholders; 4 contradicted ownership attributions; 7 oligarch orphan nodes needing owned_by edges from corpus doc 74; suspect-yacht resolutions incl. EIV 160m→48.8m and MYSTERE 109m→33.29m unit errors; Olympic Yacht Services likely = Olympic Marine Lavrion — verify against corpus source before renaming) and research/round4/club-enrichment.md (62 clubs enriched; 7 club dupe pairs; 5 founded-year discrepancies → conflicts convention, not silent correction). Person/club enrichment mappers + graphCleanup extensions. Ownership corrections use the conflicts/provenance conventions: contradicted attributions get corrected edges with the contradiction documented, rumored-only ownership gets confidence attr not deletion. Decision: notable missing famous clubs (NYYC, Royal Yacht Squadron, RORC etc.) are NOT created this round — researcher produced no data rows for them; queue as future lane if wanted.
acceptance_criteria: Person type: nationality/industry/role/status attrs on all researched persons; ownership_confidence attr (confirmed/widely reported/rumored) on owned_by edges or person attrs; 4 contradicted attributions corrected with documented rationale; 7 oligarch owned_by edges restored from corpus grounding
Person dedupe: name-variant duplicates merged via graphCleanup map with no lost edges; institutional placeholders retyped or flagged
Yacht unit-error fixes: EIV loa 48.8, MYSTERE loa 33.29, via curated correction mechanism with provenance; RIO/MOSAIQUE flags remain
Club type: 62 clubs enriched (founded/website/city confirm); 7 dupe pairs merged; 5 founded-year discrepancies recorded via conflicts convention
All tests green (ingest+app+typecheck), pins updated deliberately, score delta recorded, no push

comments.body: AC-1 AMENDMENT (explicit, per reviewer): the "7 oligarch owned_by edges restored" clause is formally waived — verified computationally that none of the 7 target yachts (Lady Anastasia, Lena, Valerie, Phi, Royal Romance, Tango, Amadea) exist as graph nodes; restoring edges would require minting yachts, contradicting the enrich-never-mint convention. Documented in knowledge/95:59-72. The 7 yachts become a future yacht-ingestion lane (they're all notable seized-oligarch vessels — good Round 7 candidates). Review verdict PASS otherwise; one MEDIUM data defect (sheikh nationality column shift, knowledge/95:179-182) + untagged A+ edge being fixed before close.
